name: Plate XXIV: The Enneagram
description: Gurdjieff's symbol of perpetual motion: the Law of Three in the triangle, the Law of Seven in the circulating figure 1-4-2-8-5-7. Struck in Rubedo: the reddening, the last stage, the Stone made perfect. Degree of Adept, rank 72 of the folio. “ΓΝΩΘΙ ΣΕΑΥΤΟΝ”: Know thyself (the Delphic maxim).
